## Human approval and merge

Review the final revision under the
[delivery criteria](https://github.com/nokamoto/agent-pulse-hub/blob/main/docs/aidd/README.md#4-delivery)
and [approval routes](https://github.com/nokamoto/agent-pulse-hub/blob/main/docs/aidd/README.md#human-approval-routes).
The responsible human may approve by personally merging the final revision.
Delivery completes only after all scoped criteria are met and approval and
merge are verified. PR preparation does not authorize external actions or merge.
